_comment: Oil and gas (scripts/sim/energy.gd), for Tankers companies. Fields: real offshore oil and gas fields (kind oil or gas), each with slots (shared by every company, first come; at most max_share of a field's slots a company) and its richness (a rig's output against the average). A slot holds an oil rig (oil fields) or a gas platform (gas fields), bought for its cost: a rig pumps output_t tons of crude oil a year times the field's richness and its upgrades, plus gas_share as much again of gas; a platform output_t of gas a year; gas comes out lng_share LNG and the rest LPG. What it makes goes into its company's storage at the field (storage tons a rig, Bigger storage more); full, it stops. Ships collect it on rig runs (a tanker or gas carrier shuttling between the field and a delivery port), or a pipeline (pipeline_cost + pipeline_per_nm a sea mile, if the company's HQ or a hub is within pipeline_nm) sends it into the company's store at that port. Storms over a field shut it while they pass (shut_at); a strong one (damage_at) may damage it (damage_odds a day, hardened half): damaged, it makes half; damaged twice it stops, till one of the company's tugs sails out and repairs it (repair_days, repair_fee a step of damage). Rigs and platforms pay wages each pay period; sold back for sale_share of their cost, or listed for other Tankers companies. Buildings: built at any port by a company (one of each a port), each turning its input into its output (yield tons of output a ton of input) at rate tons of input a day, from its company's store at the port (tank_days of its rate a tank, input and output; Bigger tanks double it) into it; only the company's own ships deliver input (unloading it there, or buying it elsewhere for a port with room in its tank), and its ships load the outputs free. A building's upgrade costs its share of the building's cost. tier: the Tankers tier that unlocks it (and rigs, platforms and pipelines). Companies' own ships bunker free from the Diesel in their store at a port.
